data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 14.449 million, representing a 12.39% reduction in opening gross claims outstanding. This was primarily driven by favorable claims development across older underwriting years (2018-2020) as calculated from the gross claims development triangle. The 2020 year of account specifically closed at a profit of GBP 0.7 million. However, the report's narrative states a net adverse prior year development of GBP 12.3 million, indicating a net strengthening, which contradicts the gross triangle calculation. The syndicate was exposed to Hurricane Ian in the current year and has an estimated GBP 1.5 million ultimate loss from the conflict in Ukraine.

The gross figure from the triangle is used as per instructions.
